question: What do iPhone XR reviewers say about battery life?
answer:
One reviewer said the iPhone XR's battery life is extraordinary and that a 12-watt iPad charger restored it from 20% to full in two hours. [a8b5849184bc_0]
Another reviewer said the iPhone XR's battery life is great. [d65cb520fe6f_0]
One reviewer said the battery life doesn't last long as it's supposed to. [b69b99669e3c_0]
One reviewer reported their unit arrived with 91% battery life. [14e0ce0a3b9f_0]
Another reviewer reported their unit arrived with 92% battery health. [b4af77c09b61_0]
One reviewer complained that their unit's battery capacity was lower than their old XR phone that had been in heavy daily use for four years. [2fd1446e5543_0]

chunks.text: 91% Battery life. I'm grateful for the quality of this purchase. We have 3 other iPhone Xr devices that we bought new and we try our best to take care of them. This iPhone Xr is on par with those phones. I will definitely look to buy my next iPhone from this seller.
iPhone xr. Great phone. But battery life doesn’t last long as suppose to.

I’m delighted with my refurbished iPhone XR. Phone was by all appearances a new product. Apple has automated transfer of apps & data between their phones. I’m delighted with my purchase! Face recognition is beyond great. Battery life is extraordinary. 12 watt iPad charger restored battery from 20% to full 100% in 2 Hrs.
iPhone XR. Battery life is great, quality is great, everything is good

Worth it. It’s as advertised.. Mine came with 91% battery life along with a screen protector. It’s definitely a good deal if you want a good phone for a cheap price. In addition, XR will get a few more years of IOS update, so if you’re looking to upgrade, it’s best to get it now.

Battery life 90%. It is truly an iPhone XR and with this price I expected there will be no headphone and the charger is nor original. Works fine and I think my 11 year old sooner-will-be-middle-schooler boy likes this birthday gift very much. The only negative thing is the battery life is only 90%, which tells me this phone must be used possible a year already. But can’t blame more, if I expect 100%, I should spend more than $500 at apple store.

Great iPhone XR. This iPhone XR of 64GB came in pretty much excellent condition with a 92% battery life and it’s working great so far. A month using it and I’m very happy. The product was better than what I was expecting

Brand new iPhone XR. I recently switched back to iPhone from an android phone and even though the android was fantastic I had to return to Apple. The phone I received was in brand new condition and the battery life was @100%. I have the seller a 5 star rating and will order again in the future.

Amazon Renewed XR with 90% battery health is actually 50% through its useful lifespan.... Got my Amazon Renewed iPhone XR from TRADEMORE. As advertised, the "renewed" phone //could// come with a 90% battery health. Yep, it showed up with a 92% battery health. If you think that's an "A" and it must have 92 more percents to go before it's dead, you're mistaken... At 80% battery health, Apple flags your phone as "significantly degraded" and notes that it is in need of service to function correctly and reliably. Around that time, Apple throttles your device performance to keep it alive on a charge. What this means is that 80% means your phone is in "hospice care" and less, you're dead. That means that a 90% battery health stat means your phone has only 50% of its remaining potential charges left before Apple deems your phone ready to leave this world.

Battery Life. I realize that the description says 80% minimum battery life, but come on. My old XR phone (same model as one purchased) had more battery maximum capacity life and it's been in heavy daily use for 4 years. And I didn't get a SIM removal tool either. Luckily I had an extra.
